title: Pickleball Christmas Shirt, Santa's Naughty List Kitchen Violators, Funny Pickleball Holiday Sweatshirt
description:
Stepped in the kitchen again? Santa saw that. A warm, wink-and-a-nudge Christmas joke for anyone who has ever committed a non-volley zone fault.

Who it's for:
- Players who live in fear of the kitchen line
- Secret Santa gifts for the pickleball group chat
- Anyone who likes their holiday humour a little cheeky, never mean

About the design:
Big cream block lettering over a Santa-hatted pickleball, with a gold header and a lime 'I can explain.' punchline.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Santa's Naughty List design reading Kitchen Violators with a Santa-hatted pickleball on a forest green sweatshirt.
